Package in.co.rays.proj4.controller

Interface ORSView

public interface ORSView
ORSView defines all application view paths and controller URLs. It acts as a centralized place for: - JSP view locations - Controller URL mappings - Application context configuration Benefits: - Avoids hardcoding paths across the application - Improves maintainability and readability - Ensures consistency in navigation Structure: - APP_CONTEXT â†’ base context path of the application - PAGE_FOLDER â†’ folder containing JSP views - *_VIEW â†’ JSP page paths - *_CTL â†’ Controller URL mappings Naming Convention: - VIEW â†’ used for forwarding to JSP pages - CTL â†’ used for redirecting to controllers Example: - LOGIN_VIEW â†’ /jsp/LoginView.jsp - LOGIN_CTL â†’ /ORSProject-04/LoginCtl This interface is used across controllers for navigation.
